requirements.quote: Add tenant tables `portfolio`, `portfolio_case` (proceeding or CNR/case number, source, status fields, next date, last adverse order) and `portfolio_panel_advocate` (advocate user delegated for the institution)
plus a workspace kind for institutions
a migration (next free number), FORCE RLS via tenantTable()
update packages/db/src/index.test.ts, the RLS catalog in packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts, TABLE_TESTS/registry and the two-tenant seeders
Acceptance: RLS tests prove tenant B sees nothing of A.

deliverables.change: New file. portfolio (id, name, timestamps), portfolio_case (portfolio composite FK (workspace_id,portfolio_id); optional composite FK to proceeding; cnr with CNR_PATTERN check; case_number; source_id FK to source; status text, status_fields jsonb or columns, next_date date, last_adverse_order_at/id; target check cnr or case_number or proceeding; unique per portfolio+cnr), portfolio_panel_advocate (portfolio composite FK, advocate_user_id FK user cascade, unique (workspace_id,portfolio_id,advocate_user_id)). All via tenantTable() with (workspace_id,id) unique and explicit workspace FK cascade, modelled on schema/webhooks.ts and schema/case-watch.ts.
Export the three tables and constants/types.
Add 'institution' to WORKSPACE_KINDS (organization_kind_chk follows via inList); update doc comment.

Use next free timestamp after 20261024100000 (renumber if base took it). CREATE the 3 tables, FKs, indexes, ENABLE+FORCE RLS and ws_isolation policies as in 20261024063416_webhooks.sql; drop and re-add organization_kind_chk with ('solo','chamber','institution'). Include the header comments the migration linter requires.

Append idx 87 entry with tag matching D4 and increasing 'when'. Add matching snapshot migrations/meta/<ts>_snapshot.json (run pnpm --filter @causedeck/db db:generate then adjust SQL header, or hand-produce).
Add portfolio, portfolio_case, portfolio_panel_advocate to the root table list.
Add the three tables to the RLS catalog.
Add the three tables to the DB_TABLES_TEST registry.
Add TENANT_SEEDERS for portfolio, portfolio_case, portfolio_panel_advocate (seed a portfolio per tenant; case and panel advocate seeders create their own parent portfolio, as webhook_delivery does).
New schema test: tables are tenant tables, checks (CNR, target), uniques, institution kind accepted by organization_kind_chk.

decisions.choice: Add 'institution' only to the DB WORKSPACE_KINDS, not to validators/UI kind lists.

decisions.choice: Model portfolio_case after case_watch (composite FKs, CNR_PATTERN check, target check).
